verdict.rationale: Vapi is a SaaS voice-AI platform, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions model training, a training opt-out, or zero-data-retention terms. The closest items are the HIPAA compliance mode, which restricts use to approved providers and controls how recordings and logs are stored. That is adjacent privacy posture, not a documented guarantee that customer data is excluded from AI training.
